solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Make example of a Director involved in cut

indicators.note: involved in says the first pieces sit inside the word for cut

parts.note: to pare is to cut or trim

explanation.surface: Someone urges that a film director caught up in a cutback be made an example of.
explanation.definitionFit: To parade someone is to display them publicly, often to shame them as an example to others.

clue.text: Direct target visible under sun

indicators.note: in a down clue, under puts the second piece below the first

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for sun, as on a weekday listing
an end is an aim or target

explanation.surface: An archer aims at a bullseye showing clearly in the sunlight.
explanation.definitionFit: To send something is to direct it towards a destination or recipient.

clue.text: Female right to secure houses after intrusion by lecturer and detective

parts.note: she is the female pronoun
to lock is to secure a door

indicators.note: after intrusion by means the lecturer's letter breaks into the word for houses

parts.note: homes are houses
L stands for lecturer, as in university staff titles

explanation.surface: A woman's right to keep her home safe after a break-in by a lecturer and a detective.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue runs across two lights; 'after intrusion by' puts L inside HOMES.
explanation.definitionFit: Conan Doyle's Baker Street sleuth is the most famous fictional detective of all.

clue.text: Intimidating figure's to keep going

definitions.meaning: a fierce, formidable person, especially a stern older woman
to continue tediously for too long, as a meeting does

explanation.surface: Someone frightening has the stamina to keep pressing on.
explanation.definitionFit: A fearsome person is called a dragon, and a tedious event is said to drag on.

clue.text: Sound of one arriving: friend sporting new sash

indicators.note: Sound of says the word for one arriving is to be heard, not spelt

parts.note: a comer is someone who comes or arrives

indicators.note: sporting means wearing, so the friend has the new letter on inside

parts.note: bud is American slang for a friend or buddy

explanation.surface: A newcomer's pal turns up wearing a brand-new sash.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the broad pleated waistband worn with a dinner jacket, a kind of formal sash.

clue.text: Seem upset about bridge support — I don't know why

indicators.note: about means the shuffled letters go around the support
upset means the letters of seem are knocked into a new order

parts.note: an arch is a structure supporting a bridge

explanation.surface: An engineer, baffled, wonders why a bridge's support appears unsettled.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' gives SEME, which 'about' places either side of the support word.
explanation.definitionFit: An informal reply that the speaker has no idea, as if to say go ahead and look.

clue.text: Big grey creature, one with power to move suddenly, surrounded by worried mahouts

indicators.note: surrounded by means the middle pieces sit inside the shuffled letters
worried means the letters of mahouts are agitated into a new order

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
P is the physics symbol for power
to pop is to go or move quickly and suddenly, as in pop out

explanation.surface: A huge grey beast bolts, hemmed in by anxious elephant keepers.
explanation.walkthrough: A mahout is an elephant driver, so the elephant picture points away from the real beast; 'worried' splits its letters either side of IPPOP.
explanation.definitionFit: The massive grey river animal of Africa fits a big grey creature.

clue.text: Stick piano hard by golden Greek statue

parts.note: a cane is a walking stick
P is the musical marking for piano, softly
H is the pencil grading for hard
or is the heraldic word for gold

explanation.surface: A walking stick, a piano and a hard golden item sit beside a Greek statue.
explanation.definitionFit: A canephor is a carved figure of a maiden bearing a basket on her head, a classical Greek sculptural type.

clue.text: Some acute rigidity observed in body cavities

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A doctor notes severe stiffness found in a patient's internal cavities.
explanation.definitionFit: The womb is a hollow organ, and these are its plural, so they are body cavities in which things are observed.

clue.text: Run after bishop, providing bag

indicators.note: after puts the run's word behind the bishop's letter

parts.note: B is the chess abbreviation for bishop
a ladder is a run in stockings or tights

explanation.surface: A clergyman is chased, with the condition that he supplies a bag.
explanation.walkthrough: A ladder is the British word for a run in tights.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a membranous sac in the body, or the inflatable bag inside a football.

clue.text: People who join together (of course) to do for mythical monster

parts.note: those who band together are banders
natch is slang short for naturally, meaning of course

explanation.surface: Allies unite, naturally, to finish off a legendary beast.
explanation.definitionFit: Lewis Carroll invented this fearsome fabled creature in Jabberwocky and The Hunting of the Snark.

clue.text: Drum rolls brought in Republicans — sweet

indicators.note: brought in means the shuffled letters are placed inside the party initials

parts.note: the GOP, Grand Old Party, is the US Republican Party

indicators.note: rolls means the letters of drum tumble into a new order

explanation.surface: A drum roll heralds the arrival of Republicans, which is lovely.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Drum rolls' reads as a noun phrase, but 'rolls' is the anagram signal; GOP is the Grand Old Party.
explanation.definitionFit: A chewy jelly confection is a kind of sweet, or candy.

clue.text: Recalled desire to embrace Edward, clinging

indicators.note: to embrace means the turned word wraps around the name
Recalled means the word for desire is called back, read in reverse

parts.note: a yen is a longing or desire
Ed is short for Edward

explanation.surface: A remembered longing to hug Edward, holding on tightly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Recalled' gives NEY, the longing word turned round, before the name goes inside.
explanation.definitionFit: A clingy, dependent person is described as emotionally needy.

clue.text: Pulling in line between yards with great desire

indicators.note: between means the middle pieces sit inside the pair of letters

parts.note: Y is the abbreviation for yard, so two yards give two of it
pulling in money is earning it

explanation.surface: Someone eagerly hauls a rope in between garden plots.
explanation.walkthrough: The two yards split, one either side of EARNING plus L.
explanation.definitionFit: To do something longingly, with strong wanting, is to do it this way.

clue.text: Title that hurts shrine rebuilt by priest

parts.note: ow is the cry you give when something hurts

indicators.note: rebuilt means the letters of shrine are put together in a new order

explanation.surface: A painful legal claim over a rebuilt shrine, made by the priest.
explanation.definitionFit: In law, title means the right of possession of property.

clue.text: Mare disfigured on chest — symbol of 14?

indicators.note: disfigured means the letters of mare are marred into a new order

parts.note: an ark is a chest or box, like the Ark of the Covenant

explanation.surface: A horse scarred on its chest bears a brand of possession.
explanation.definitionFit: A notch cut in a sheep's or cow's ear marked whose animal it was, a sign of possession.

clue.text: Others upset at variable resistance

indicators.note: upset means the letters of others are overturned into a new order

explanation.surface: Other people are annoyed about fluctuating opposition.
explanation.definitionFit: An electrical component whose resistance can be adjusted to control current is a variable resistor.

clue.text: Well-off advanced after reduction in work

indicators.note: after puts the loaned word behind the shortened work
reduction in means the work's word is cut short by its last letter

parts.note: an opus is a work, especially of music
money advanced is lent

explanation.surface: A wealthy person got a loan after their hours were cut.
explanation.definitionFit: Opulent means wealthy or luxurious, as a well-off person is.

clue.text: Glass is raised by detective in Scottish town

indicators.note: in places the pieces inside the town's name

parts.note: Oban is a port town in western Scotland

indicators.note: in a down clue, raised means the word is read upwards, reversed

parts.note: DI is a Detective Inspector

explanation.surface: A glass is lifted by a police detective in a Scottish town.
explanation.definitionFit: This dark natural volcanic glass forms when lava cools quickly.

clue.text: Blades 24s used in struggle

indicators.note: in struggle means the letters fight their way into a new order

parts.note: the answer to 24 down, made plural

explanation.surface: Swords were used by Asian rulers in battle.
explanation.walkthrough: The plural of the 24 down answer plus USED is rearranged. These are the daggers worn in the sock with Highland dress.
explanation.definitionFit: These are Scottish daggers tucked into the top of a stocking, so they are blades.

clue.text: See 3
Backed one note in medical material

indicators.note: Backed means the whole assembled piece is read backwards
in places the pieces inside the medical abbreviation

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A medical document has one note supported in it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts I and N inside MED, giving MINED; 'Backed' turns that round.
explanation.definitionFit: This hard-wearing cotton twill used for jeans is a material, or fabric.

clue.text: Latticework headgear not one to annoy

parts.note: a net is a mesh, a kind of latticework

indicators.note: not with one means the letter for one is dropped from the hat word

parts.note: tile is old slang for a hat
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A mesh hat lacking a single piece irritates its wearer.
explanation.walkthrough: Tile as a hat is old British slang.
explanation.definitionFit: To irritate or provoke someone is to rile them, the verb sense.

clue.text: Soccer team showing skill in Rome, way back

parts.note: ars is the Latin word for skill or art, as spoken in ancient Rome

indicators.note: back means the word for way is read in reverse

parts.note: a lane is a way or road

explanation.surface: A football side displays flair in Rome on the way back home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns LANE into ENAL. The Gunners are the North London Premier League club.
explanation.definitionFit: This North London club is one of the best-known English football sides.

clue.text: Information's located about knockout US states

indicators.note: located about means the word for information sits around the knockout letters

parts.note: data is information; with the apostrophe s it gives that word plus S
KO is the boxing abbreviation for knockout

explanation.surface: Records are found concerning a knockout in American states.
explanation.definitionFit: North and South are the two neighbouring states of the American Midwest sharing one name.

clue.text: SF film villain: King taking on Solo?

parts.note: K is the chess abbreviation for king
Han Solo is the Star Wars smuggler

explanation.surface: A science-fiction baddie: a king taking on a Star Wars hero?
explanation.walkthrough: The villain of Star Trek II takes Han Solo's first name from a rival franchise.
explanation.definitionFit: The genetically enhanced tyrant of Star Trek II is a famous science-fiction movie villain.

clue.text: Caught nude by lake — some swimming?

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught
in the raw means naked

explanation.surface: Someone skinny-dipping near a lake is caught; were they swimming?
explanation.definitionFit: Front stroke is a style of swimming, so it is some swimming.

clue.text: Time before book's covered by special offer is readily forgotten

indicators.note: before puts the time word ahead of the rest

parts.note: an era is a period of time

indicators.note: covered by means the book letter sits inside the offer word

parts.note: a sale is a special offer of reduced prices
B is the abbreviation for book; the 's is a link

explanation.surface: In time, a book discounted in a promotion soon slips from memory.
explanation.definitionFit: Something easily wiped out, as from memory, is capable of being deleted.
